purpose: Exploit a favorable circumstance for selfish behavior.
keywords: Plain clause + のをいいことに; N / な-adjective + なのをいいことに
Taking advantage of nobody watching, he ate all the sweets.
They took advantage of my absence to use the room without asking.
They used the lack of a reply as an excuse to proceed.
formation: Plain clause + のをいいことに; N / な-adjective + なのをいいことに
mistake: It usually conveys disapproval, not a neutral opportunity.
